title: Add product filtering by shape and category tabs to Marketplace header and create description template management system

requirements.summary: Add filter tabs to the Marketplace home page header that display all available shapes and categories as clickable tabs, allowing customers to filter the displayed products
acceptanceCriteria: Filter tabs appear in the Marketplace page header above the product sections
Tabs display all unique shapes from products in the system
Tabs display all unique categories from products in the system
Clicking a shape or category tab filters the product display to show only matching products
Users can select multiple filters (e.g., one shape + one category) to narrow results
Active filters are visually indicated with distinct styling
A 'Clear Filters' or 'All Products' option resets the filter state

file_operations.description: Add a FilterTabs section in the header area below the hero section and above the product sections. Extract unique shapes and categories from the products data. Render clickable tabs for each shape and category with active state styling. Include an 'All Products' tab to clear filters. Wire the filter state to control which tabs appear selected.

requirements.summary: Create React state management in Marketplace.tsx to track selected shape and category filters, and implement filtering logic that filters the product arrays based on the active filter selections
acceptanceCriteria: Filter state tracks currently selected shapes and categories
Product lists dynamically update when filters change
Filtering preserves the original product section structure (featured, most viewed, etc.)
Empty states display appropriate messages when no products match the selected filters

file_operations.description: Add useState hooks to track selectedShapes and selectedCategories arrays. Implement filtering logic that applies to featuredProducts, mostViewedProducts, bestSellingProducts, and newestProducts arrays. Filter products by checking if product.shape matches any selected shape and if a category field (when implemented) matches any selected category. Display empty state messages when filtered arrays are empty. Preserve the section structure by rendering sections even when filtered.

requirements.summary: Add a new 'Description Templates' tab to the admin Dashboard page with a management interface that displays all existing description templates in a list or table format with options to create new templates, edit existing templates, and delete templates
acceptanceCriteria: New 'Description Templates' tab appears in the Dashboard page navigation
Interface displays all existing description templates with their names and content preview
Create button opens a form to add a new description template
Each template has edit and delete action buttons
Templates are saved and persisted in the backend

file_operations.description: Add a new 'Description Templates' tab to the Tabs component alongside Products, Bulk Upload, Branding, Shop Details, and Homepage tabs. In the TabsContent for Description Templates, render a list or table of templates fetched using useDescriptionTemplates hook. Display template name and a truncated content preview. Add a 'Create New Template' button that opens the DescriptionTemplateManager component in create mode. For each template row, include edit and delete action buttons that trigger the appropriate mutations or open the manager in edit mode.

requirements.summary: Create a DescriptionTemplateManager component that provides a form interface for creating and editing description templates with fields for template name and template content text, with save and cancel controls
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes template name input field
Form includes template content textarea for the description text
Save button validates required fields and submits to backend
Cancel button resets form or closes the editor
Form supports both create and edit modes
Success feedback displays after successful save

file_operations.description: Create a form component with Input for template name and Textarea for template content. Accept props for mode ('create' or 'edit'), existing template data (for edit mode), and callbacks for onSave and onCancel. Use useState to manage form fields. Implement validation to ensure name and content are non-empty. On save, call useCreateDescriptionTemplate or useUpdateDescriptionTemplate mutation hooks depending on mode. Display success toast on successful save. Render Save and Cancel buttons with appropriate handlers. Use shadcn/ui Form, Input, Textarea, and Button components for consistent styling.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hooks for fetching all description templates (useDescriptionTemplates) and mutating description templates (useCreateDescriptionTemplate, useUpdateDescriptionTemplate, useDeleteDescriptionTemplate) with admin authentication
acceptanceCriteria: useDescriptionTemplates hook fetches all templates from backend
useCreateDescriptionTemplate hook creates new templates
useUpdateDescriptionTemplate hook updates existing templates
useDeleteDescriptionTemplate hook removes templates
All mutation hooks invalidate the templates query on success
Hooks include proper error handling and loading states

file_operations.description: Add useDescriptionTemplates query hook that calls actor.getDescriptionTemplates() with queryKey ['descriptionTemplates']. Add useCreateDescriptionTemplate mutation hook that calls actor.createDescriptionTemplate(name, content) and invalidates ['descriptionTemplates'] on success. Add useUpdateDescriptionTemplate mutation hook that calls actor.updateDescriptionTemplate(id, name, content) and invalidates ['descriptionTemplates'] on success. Add useDeleteDescriptionTemplate mutation hook that calls actor.deleteDescriptionTemplate(id) and invalidates ['descriptionTemplates'] on success. Include proper error handling in all hooks using React Query's error handling patterns.

requirements.summary: Update the BulkProductUpload component to replace the single default description template with a dropdown selector that displays all available description templates from the template management system, allowing the trader to select which template to use as the default pre-populated description for bulk uploaded products
acceptanceCriteria: Template selector dropdown appears above the product upload grid
Dropdown displays all available templates by name
Selecting a template pre-populates the description field for all products with that template's content
Template selection works with the existing auto-copy functionality
Default template is selected automatically if only one exists
Template selection persists during the upload session

file_operations.description: Add useDescriptionTemplates hook to fetch available templates. Add a Select component above the product grid to display template options by name. Add state to track the currently selected template ID. When a template is selected, populate the description field of all products in the grid with the selected template's content. Integrate this with the existing auto-copy functionality so that when a template is selected, it updates the first product's description and triggers auto-copy to propagate to other products if enabled. If only one template exists, automatically select it on component mount. Preserve template selection state during the upload session using useState.
